title: Tailwise Autoship Tenure Credit on Error-Return Refunds
content:
**Member benefit statement - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders.**

An error-return refund carries an Autoship-tenure credit that counts whole months since the enrollment date of the customer's active Tailwise Autoship subscription.

| Whole months since the active Tailwise Autoship subscription was enrolled | Autoship-tenure credit |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | $1.50 |
| 12 or more, but fewer than 36 | $0.75 |
| Fewer than 12, or no active Autoship subscription | Nothing |

**Whole months.** A month counts as whole once the day of the month of the enrollment date is reached again; a subscription enrolled on 10 March has run 12 whole months on 10 March of the next year and 11 on 9 March.

### Both sides of the thresholds (hypothetical, today 2026-03-10)

| Enrollment date of the active subscription | Whole months | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 2023-03-11 | 35 | $0.75 |
| 2023-03-10 | 36 | $1.50 |
| 2025-03-11 | 11 | Nothing |
| 2025-03-10 | 12 | $0.75 |

A subscription in any status other than active on the Tailwise Autoship record is not the active subscription this credit reads.
